_comment: Pinned external sources for Baseline/paper_baselines. fetch_sources.py clones each into external/<name>/ and checks out the exact SHA. HEADs confirmed with git ls-remote on 2026-10-23. License fields are filled from the LICENSE file of the pinned checkout (see license_file); re-run `fetch_sources.py --check` to verify.

sources.name: Grounded-SAM-2
sources.role: grounded_sam2 provider: HF Grounding DINO + SAM 2 recipe; editable-installed as the `sam2` package into .venv-baselines

sources.name: Grounded-Segment-Anything
sources.role: reference only: Grounded-SAM v1 demo thresholds / box selection; not executed (its GroundingDINO CUDA op is avoided via HF transformers)

sources.name: yoloe
sources.role: reference only: YOLOE text-prompt seg recipe; executed through the pinned ultralytics wheel

sources.name: TokenCut
sources.role: B: parity reference for tokencut re-implementation (object_discovery.ncut)

sources.name: LocalizationHeads
sources.role: B: head selection criteria (Kang et al. CVPR 2025) applied to pi0.5 attention
sources.license: none at pinned SHA (no LICENSE file; README states MIT) -- not vendored, re-implemented with citations
